card.name: Researcher names in news and citations
card.fires_on: Pieces of a person's name, usually a researcher or doctor, inside a news story or reference list. It fires on first names, name endings like -ias or -ded, and initials with periods before a surname.

modes.label: Split first names
modes.description: The middle or end of a first name that is split into pieces, just before the surname.
modes.example: research groups headed by Math<<ias>> Jucker are now following

modes.label: Initials and name links
modes.description: A period after an initial, or 'and' between authors, in citations just before the next name.
modes.example: R. Klemetti, M<<.>> Gissler, M. Niin

modes.label: Name after Dr.
modes.description: A first name right after a title such as Dr. and before the surname.
modes.example: treated by Dr.<< Hannah>> Gay at the University of Mississippi Medical Center

card.writes: It pushes toward the next piece of a surname or a short name ending, so the output is probably a plausible name continuation.
card.plain: It lights up on researcher and doctor names in news stories and reference lists, just before the surname.
